title: PixlAudio Cloud Studio lyrics (pixl.cloudstudio.lyrics v1)
description: Written to out/<jobKey>/lyrics.json. mode aligned keeps the sent text unchanged; mode transcribed is machine-written text (the app labels it "AI-written lyrics"). Words carry UTF-16 offsets into their line's text so the app rebuilds them exactly (the aligner strips punctuation). Unknown fields must be ignored.

language.description: ISO 639 code the worker used (hint or detected), or null.

offsetMs.description: Global shift applied to the sent line times before aligning (0 when none). Already included in every time below.

i.description: Index of the sent line (aligned), or the running line number (transcribed).

text.description: aligned: the sent line, unchanged. transcribed: the recognised text.

timing.description: line = word timing was not possible (unsupported language, empty or collapsed alignment); words is then empty.

text.description: The aligner's unit (a word, or one CJK character), punctuation removed.

c0.description: UTF-16 offset of the unit's first character in the line text.

c1.description: UTF-16 offset just past its last character (c0 < c1).

conf.description: Reserved. v1 workers do not emit it (the aligner reports no confidence).
